text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 3) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 6 April 2026.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan kenderaan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama,

di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama

sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua, berkuat kuasa

pada 6 April 2026, dilarang.

Pengecualian

3. Pengecualian daripada larangan itu hendaklah diberikan bagi maksud

dan dalam hal keadaan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1)

Jalan yang baginya larangan terpakai

(2)

Jenis kenderaan

Laluan 229, Jalan Permatang Badak

dari koordinat U 3.801045,

T 103.263504 hingga U 3.777770,

T 103.273192, sebagaimana yang

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam

Jadual Kedua

Kenderaan bermotor dan jentera

bergerak yang mempunyai berat tanpa

muatan lima ribu kilogram dan lebih

JADUAL KEDUA

JADUAL KETIGA

PENGECUALIAN

1. Bagi maksud penyelenggaraan, pembaikan, peningkatan, pembersihan

dan pemugaran bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

2. Bagi maksud pemacakan, pemasangan, penyelenggaraan, pengubahan

atau pengalihan mana-mana struktur, kerja, peralatan atau apa-apa benda

di dalam, pada, di bawah atau di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

3. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan kecemasan dan penguatkuasaan oleh agensi Kerajaan

dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.

4. Bagi maksud pemeriksaan, pembuangan dan penghantaran sisa domestik oleh

kenderaan berat seperti lori sampah, lori pembersihan pembetungan

dan lori vakum pembetungan.

5. Bagi maksud kecemasan, jika penggunaan mana-mana jalan selain yang terdapat

dalam koordinat yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama menjadi

mustahil atau tidak sesuai.

6. Bagi maksud pengangkutan awam.

Dibuat 1 April 2026

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.10; PN(PU2)460/JLD.141]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 3) ORDER 2026

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 113/2026 published on 18 March 2026, notice was given

of the intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Minister of Works against the making

of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to

in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 3) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 6 April 2026.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles specified in column (2) of the First Schedule,

on the part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule as shown on the map

in the Second Schedule, with effect from 6 April 2026, is prohibited.

Exemption

3. Exemption from such prohibition shall be given for the purposes

and in the circumstances specified in the Third Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

Road to which prohibition applies

(2)

Type of vehicles

Route 229, Permatang Badak Road

from coordinate N 3.801045,

E 103.263504 until N 3.777770,

E 103.273192, as shown on the map

in the Second Schedule

Motor vehicles and mobile machineries

with the unladen weight of five thousand

kilogrammes and more

SECOND SCHEDULE

THIRD SCHEDULE

EXEMPTION

1. For the purposes of maintenance, repair, improvement, cleaning and clearance

of the part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

2. For the purposes of erection, installation, maintenance, alteration or removal of

any structure, works, apparatus or any thing in, on, under or over the part

of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

3. For the purposes of emergency services and enforcement by

the Government agencies and local authorities.

4. For the purposes of checking, disposal and delivery of domestic waste by

heavy vehicle such as garbage truck, sewerage cleaning truck

and sewerage vacuum truck.

5. For the purposes of emergency, if the use of any road other than which appears

in the coordinates specified in column (1) of the First Schedule is rendered

impossible or unsuitable.

6. For the purposes of public transport.

Made 1 April 2026

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.10; PN(PU2)460/JLD.141]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Works
